product_description:
Combo Interactive 3: Student Book With Web Zone Access + Workbook

1. Interactive 3 SB With Web Zone Access

Interactive is an exciting course for teenagers, packed with up-to-the-minute, stimulating content. It will get your students talking and keep them talking, using real, contemporary English.

A realistic Graphic Novel runs through the Student's Book, which teens can read just for fun. There are optional activities available in the Teacher's Book and online.

Interactive is an exciting course for teenagers, packed with up-to-the-minute, stimulating content. It will get your students talking and keep them talking, using real, contemporary English.

- Every unit provides one core reading text and additional listening practice.

- A fun Quiz at the end of each unit enables students to review what they have learnt and promotes learner autonomy.

- The 24-page grammar section at the back of the Workbook offers a Grammar reference and Grammar practice linked to every unit of the Student's Book.
